title: Delve is live
text: The game is up at stippo47.github.io/delve and works offline once it's opened.
why: Try it on the iPhone: open the link in Safari, Share, Add to Home Screen, then launch it from there in landscape. Say how it feels: speed, touch, anything off.
details:
https://stippo47.github.io/delve/

Checked in a desktop browser at phone size: camp loads, a depth 1 run plays, no errors, and the offline copy saves. Not checked on a real iPhone yet, so frame rate, Low Power Mode and touch are still unknown.
